title: Interior and cargo room
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on cabin, rear-seat, and trunk space, with clear praise for spaciousness but several fragments that are comparative or too vague to assign a firm sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the G70 for excellent interior room, roomy rear seating, easy entry and exit, and ample overall space including the cabin.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention room or storage in comparative, advertising-related, or too-brief ways that do not clearly establish a definite sentiment toward the G70’s space.

limitations: Several fragments are comparative or incomplete, so the sample does not support a more specific conclusion about whether customers mean passenger room, cargo room, or storage in every case.
The topic includes related but distinct space themes such as cabin room, rear-seat room, trunk room, and storage, which limits how narrowly the cluster can be summarized.
